data_dependencies: point-in-time Massive equity price, volume, NBBO, news, reference, and market-context data
point-in-time earnings, guidance, filing, financing, dilution, regulatory, and corporate-action evidence
explicit causal decision and outcome timestamps
causal_inputs.decision_time_rule: Freeze catalyst knowledge and market evidence at the research decision timestamp; later news may label outcomes only.
causal_inputs.completed_bar_rule: Use completed bars through T-1 and label current partial-bar or quote evidence separately.
causal_inputs.missing_data_rule: Record unavailable catalyst, filing, quote, and corporate-action fields as UNKNOWN; do not infer or backfill from later disclosures.

setup_rules: UNKNOWN until a prospective catalyst taxonomy, gap behavior, liquidity regime, and consolidation/reacceleration definition are versioned
candidate research must distinguish verified catalyst, checked-none, unavailable, stale, and conflicted states
entry_or_research_rules: research observations only; no broker review, risk authorization, buying-power reservation, or order
proposed one-to-five-session horizons must be declared at T and may not be optimized after the outcome
exit_or_outcome_rules: UNKNOWN until frozen target, invalidation, gap-through, cost, and mandatory evaluation horizons are prospectively defined
outcomes must report both path-dependent R and overnight gap/tail loss without treating a stop as guaranteed
invalidations: catalyst contradiction, financing or dilution, security-status failure, stale quote, failed liquidity, or unavailable point-in-time evidence
any attempted LIVE, PAPER, broker, risk, or allocation action under this SHADOW-only contract

notes: Overnight behavior is research-only and cannot override the live no-overnight rule.

lane_risk_translation.notional_rule: UNKNOWN; no notional, quantity, buying power, or capital is authorized or reserved.
lane_risk_translation.stop_defined_risk_rule: UNKNOWN until a causal swing invalidation and next-session gap model are validated.
lane_risk_translation.stress_loss_rule: Must model overnight gap, halt, dilution, financing, and correlated catalyst tails before promotion evidence can be complete.
lane_adjustments: separate earnings, regulatory, financing, contract, analyst, and sympathy catalyst regimes
separate liquid large-cap and lower-liquidity equity execution regimes
do not transfer intraday no-overnight risk assumptions into swing research

cost_execution_model.quote_source: UNKNOWN until continuous causal bid/ask coverage and a tradable instrument intersection are verified.
cost_execution_model.spread_model: UNKNOWN; future research must use decision-time executable spread rather than full-day or backfilled spread.
cost_execution_model.slippage_model: UNKNOWN; must include open gaps, market impact, halt resumption, and exit slippage.
cost_execution_model.fee_model: UNKNOWN; report unavailable costs explicitly rather than assuming zero.
cost_execution_model.fill_model: UNKNOWN; same-bar confirmation and fill are prohibited without event-sequenced quotes or ticks.
cost_execution_model.maximum_contractual_loss_rule: For long equity there is no contractual stop guarantee; report stress and gap loss separately.

session_calendar_rules.calendar: U.S. equity trading calendar with corporate-action and halt awareness
session_calendar_rules.research_or_entry_window: SHADOW research timestamps only; proposed one-to-five-session windows remain unimplemented.
session_calendar_rules.mandatory_flat_rule: NOT_APPLICABLE_SHADOW_ONLY; any future overnight authority requires a new explicit contract.
session_calendar_rules.holiday_rule: No synthetic trading-session progression on market holidays; label calendar gaps explicitly.

entry_or_research_kill_conditions: point-in-time catalyst or corporate-action provenance unavailable
future leakage, survivorship contamination, or overlapping ticker-session double counting detected
execution or overnight-tail model absent for a claimed profitability result
any non-SHADOW book mode or nonzero trade, risk, reservation, or allocation authority
suspension_criteria.operator_stop_semantics: Registered SHADOW research is zero-authority; any future runtime research stop must be explicit and may never release the LIVE emergency-entry stop.

known_failure_modes: overnight gaps can bypass modeled invalidation
catalyst interpretation can be stale or wrong
financing or dilution can reverse a favorable move
ticker-session observations are not independent across one catalyst regime
